Your Grace,

### Goal
Identify missing/weak unit tests in `apps/cli` and propose a focused test plan. No code changes.

### Testing stack
- **Primary**: Vitest (already used) — stable, mature.
- **Mocks**: Inline `vi.mock`, fs/process timers, and targeted stubs for `blessed`/`blessed-contrib`.
- **Optional (novel, optional)**: `fast-check` for property-based cases (parsers); Stryker for mutation insights.

### Prioritized backlog (top → bottom impact)
- **Core engines**: `MetricsEngine`, `Workflow`, `TaskQueue`, `BatchPipeline`, `NaturalLanguageProcessor`, `Chronometer`
- **High-usage commands**: `tag`, `test`, `stats`, `taxonomy`
- **Infra/health**: `HealthChecker`, `SystemMonitor`, `DaemonService`, `ContentDiscovery`
- **Dashboard layer**: `DashboardManager`, widgets, helpers, command helpers
- **Glue**: `config-interactive` edge cases, `config` advanced flows, `natural`, `workflow`, `analyze`, `commands.ts`, `index.ts`
- **Utilities**: `Formatters`, frontmatter edge cases (where missing)

### File-by-file plan and key cases

- `apps/cli/src/ai/discovery/ContentDiscovery.ts`
  - Add: scans maxDepth enforcement; `includeHidden`; `excludePatterns`; text preview; error aggregation; event emissions order (`discovery:*`).
  - Mocks: `fs.promises`, time.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/analyze.ts`
  - Add: options matrix toggles (`deep/sentiment/trends/predict/ai`); each formatter path (`report/json/dashboard/export`); compare mode prints; minimal golden-output assertions.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/config-interactive.ts`
  - Extend: no API key branch (empty model choices); model fetch failure path; profile save writes; taxonomy copy success/skip/error; export path mkdir/write failures; advanced validations (vault path non-existent, numeric validators).

- `apps/cli/src/commands/config.ts`
  - Extend: `set` with JSON vs string; model validation branches (valid/invalid/no key/confirm false); `export` yaml/json; `import` missing file; profile lifecycle (create/list/use/delete), confirm delete false; `validate-model` fallback path.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/dashboard.ts`
  - Add: `loadDashboardConfig` (valid file/invalid JSON fallback/defaults); `formatGraphData` correctness; `setupMetricsCollection` updates widgets when metrics fire (mock `DashboardManager` and `MetricsEngine`).

- `apps/cli/src/commands/dashboard-standalone.ts`
  - Add: `normalizeOptions` normalization; `formatGraphData` correctness; `setupMetricsCollection` wiring (log/series/progress).

- `apps/cli/src/commands/health.ts`
  - Add: single check path JSON/table/detailed; `watch` loop (use fake timers) prints; `attemptAutoFix` suggestion routing; `getStatusIcon` mapping.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/natural.ts`
  - Add: interactive loop exit conditions; low-confidence suggestions; command routing for each intent; error in prompt (TTY abort).

- `apps/cli/src/commands/stats.ts` (has tests — extend)
  - Extend: `directory` analysis branch (no files/some files with tags); JSON table parity; `output` write; error for missing dir; `getPeriodDisplay` default fallback.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/tag.ts` (has tests — extend)
  - Extend: `dry-run` totals/cost estimate; `mode=differential` skip when tags exist; `interactive` flow (integration with `TagEditor` stub); cost limit pause/stop/warn behavior; existing tags extraction; progress bar disabled in interactive; output file write; error path per-file continues; cost tracking recorded.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/taxonomy.ts` (has tests — extend)
  - Extend: `add-domain` duplicate domain; `add-subdomain` missing domain / duplicate subdomain; `add-tag` write; default taxonomy path resolution; save failure handling.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/test.ts` (has tests — extend)
  - Extend: all feature switches (`integration`, `stress-test`, `optimize-params`, `test-set` dir/file); models parsing (`all-models`), no models error (process.exit guarded in non-test env); benchmark error path; report save.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/workflow.ts`
  - Add: each operation branch (`run/create/list/monitor/optimize`) prints and completes; `dry-run` optimize message; monitor loop with timers; pipeline stages generation by preset.

- `apps/cli/src/commands/commands.ts`
  - Add: returns all commands; order stable; each item has `command`/`describe`.

- `apps/cli/src/dashboard/DashboardManager.ts`
  - Add: `cycleTheme` rotation; `updateWidget` routing for all types; `getStats`; `cleanup` clears interval; ensure emits (`dashboard:started`, `widget:updated`, `theme:changed`). Mock `blessed`/`contrib`.

- `apps/cli/src/dashboard/MetricsEngine.ts`
  - Add: start/stop collection; recordMetric append/history cap; getLatestValue; subscribe/unsubscribe; stats aggregation; default collectors’ record methods mutate state as expected; `cleanup` clears intervals.

- Widgets
  - `widgets/GraphWidget.ts`: `processSeriesData` caps to `maxDataPoints`; update sets data.
  - `widgets/LogWidget.ts`: formatting levels/timestamps; line cap truncation.
  - `widgets/MetricsWidget.ts`: value formatting (number/currency/percentage).
  - `widgets/ProgressWidget.ts`: percent bounds and update.

- Layout/themes
  - `layouts/GridLayout.ts`: `validateLayout` detects overlaps/out-of-bounds; `optimizeLayout` returns consistent config; `getWidgetPositions` mapping.
  - `themes/MatrixTheme.ts`: `getTheme` returns palette, fallback selection.

- Enterprise
  - `enterprise/health/HealthChecker.ts`: add/remove checks; timeouts; overall status computation (healthy/degraded/unhealthy); metadata passthrough; last results.
  - `enterprise/monitoring/SystemMonitor.ts`: metrics assembly; thresholds trigger warning logs; start/stop state; status reporting. Mock `os`, `process`.

- QoL
  - `quality-of-life/natural-lang/NaturalLanguageProcessor.ts`: pattern coverage for all intents; entity extraction; confidence thresholds; help fallback. Optional property-based strings.
  - `quality-of-life/daemon/DaemonService.ts`: start/stop/restart transitions; pid file write/remove; watcher setup; interval processing tick; shutdown handlers. Mock fs/watch.
  - `quality-of-life/caching/SmartCache.ts`: set/get TTL expiry; strategies LRU/semantic/content-aware evictions; compression on/off; stats; import/export; similarity find.

- Utilities
  - `utils/Chronometer.ts`: `loadTestCases` ok/error; `runBenchmark` with mocked `TaggingService` producing deterministic report; percentiles; best-model selection. (Unit-level — no network).
  - `utils/workflow.ts` (`Workflow`): add/priority; concurrency respected; retries with backoff; pause/resume/cancel; stats; events. Use fake timers.
  - `workflow/pipelines/BatchPipeline.ts`: stage retries/timeout; chunking by concurrency; stats.
  - `workflow/queues/TaskQueue.ts`: enqueue ordering by priority; retry to max; pause/resume/stop; results map; cancel.
  - `utils/frontmatter.ts`: complement with edge cases if missing (nested arrays/objects; missing frontmatter; append vs update stability).
  - `utils/cost-manager.ts` (has tests): extend cost limit behaviors (warn/pause/stop), `resetPause`, `getUsageHistory` period filtering; load/save usage data IO error.
  - `utils/Formatters.ts`: paths shortening; token estimation; currency/duration formats.

- Glue
  - `src/index.ts`: `getPackageVersion` reading from package.json; command registration (smoke: yargs builder includes our commands); `initializeGodTierSystems` side-effects guarded.

### Test scaffolding to add
- Create stubs for `blessed` and `blessed-contrib` to allow headless runs.
- Common fs/process/time helpers for deterministic behavior.
- Golden-output snapshots for purely textual commands (`analyze`, parts of `workflow`, `demo` output where stable).

### Coverage targets
- Short term: raise `apps/cli` to ~80% statements/branches; critical modules ≥90% (`MetricsEngine`, `Workflow`, `tag`, `test`).
- Focus on error paths and configuration branches.

### Suggested file additions (examples)
- `apps/cli/src/ai/discovery/ContentDiscovery.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/commands/{analyze,health,natural,workflow,dashboard,dashboard-standalone}.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/dashboard/{DashboardManager,MetricsEngine}.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/dashboard/widgets/{GraphWidget,LogWidget,MetricsWidget,ProgressWidget}.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/enterprise/{health/HealthChecker,SystemMonitor}.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/quality-of-life/{natural-lang/NaturalLanguageProcessor,daemon/DaemonService,caching/SmartCache}.test.ts`
- `apps/cli/src/utils/{Chronometer,workflow,frontmatter,Formatters}.test.ts`

Your Humble Servant, Sebastién

Your Grace,

Here’s a concise, actionable unit-test plan for `apps/cli` (no code changes).

### Phase 0 — Test scaffolding
- Mocks: `blessed`, `blessed-contrib` (headless), process TTY, timers.
- Helpers: fs stubs, fake timers, golden-output helpers.
- Structure: co-locate tests next to sources under `apps/cli/src/**`.

### Phase 1 — Core engines (high-impact)
- `ai/discovery/ContentDiscovery.test.ts`
  - maxDepth, includeHidden, excludePatterns, text preview, error aggregation, events order.
- `dashboard/MetricsEngine.test.ts`
  - start/stop collection, recordMetric/history cap, subscribe/unsubscribe, stats, cleanup.
- `utils/workflow.test.ts`
  - concurrency, priority, retries/backoff, pause/resume/cancel, events, stats.
- `workflow/queues/TaskQueue.test.ts`
  - priority ordering, retry-to-max, pause/resume/stop, results map, cancel.
- `workflow/pipelines/BatchPipeline.test.ts`
  - per-stage retry/timeout, chunking by concurrency, stats.

### Phase 2 — CLI commands (extend existing + add new)
- Extend existing:
  - `commands/tag.test.ts`: dry-run totals/costs, differential skip-if-tagged, interactive (mock `TagEditor`), cost-limit warn/pause/stop, output file.
  - `commands/stats.test.ts`: directory mode (none/some files), JSON vs table parity, `--output` write, missing dir error.
  - `commands/test.test.ts`: flags (`integration`, `stress-test`, `optimize-params`, `test-set` dir/file), `all-models`, report save, benchmark error path.
  - `commands/taxonomy.test.ts`: duplicate domain, missing/duplicate subdomain, add-tag persistence, default path resolution.
  - `commands/config-interactive.test.ts`: no key → empty model choices; model fetch error; profile save; taxonomy copy (exists/success/error); export mkdir/write failure; validators.
  - `commands/config.test.ts`: `set` JSON vs string; model validation branches (no key/invalid/confirm false); export yaml/json; import not found; profile lifecycle.
- Add new:
  - `commands/health.test.ts`: single check JSON/table/detailed; watch loop (fake timers); `attemptAutoFix`; status icons.
  - `commands/analyze.test.ts`: format paths (`report/json/dashboard/export`); toggles `deep/sentiment/trends/predict/ai`; compare output.
  - `commands/workflow.test.ts`: run/create/list/monitor/optimize; dry-run optimize; monitor with fake timers.
  - `commands/dashboard.test.ts` and `commands/dashboard-standalone.test.ts`: config file load/fallback; series formatting; widget updates (mock `DashboardManager`/`MetricsEngine`).

### Phase 3 — Dashboard layer
- `dashboard/DashboardManager.test.ts`: `cycleTheme`, `updateWidget` for all types, emits (`dashboard:started`, `widget:updated`, `theme:changed`), `cleanup` clears interval.
- Widgets:
  - `widgets/GraphWidget.test.ts`: series cap to max points; setData.
  - `widgets/LogWidget.test.ts`: level/timestamp formatting; truncation.
  - `widgets/MetricsWidget.test.ts`: number/currency/percent formatting.
  - `widgets/ProgressWidget.test.ts`: percent bounds and update.

### Phase 4 — Enterprise & QoL
- `enterprise/health/HealthChecker.test.ts`: add/remove checks, timeout handling, overall health derivation, metadata passthrough, lastResults.
- `enterprise/monitoring/SystemMonitor.test.ts`: metrics assembly, threshold warnings, start/stop/state; mock `os`/`process`.
- `quality-of-life/natural-lang/NaturalLanguageProcessor.test.ts`: patterns for all intents, entity extraction, confidence thresholds, help fallback.
- `quality-of-life/caching/SmartCache.test.ts`: TTL expiry, LRU/semantic/content-aware eviction, compression on/off, stats, import/export, similarity find.
- `quality-of-life/daemon/DaemonService.test.ts`: start/stop/restart, pid file write/remove, watcher setup, periodic processing, shutdown handlers.

### Phase 5 — Utilities
- `utils/Chronometer.test.ts`: `loadTestCases` ok/error; deterministic model benchmarking (mock `TaggingService`); percentiles; best-model selection.
- `utils/frontmatter.test.ts` (extend): nested structures, missing frontmatter, append/update idempotence.
- `utils/Formatters.test.ts`: path shortening, token estimate, currency/duration formatting.

### Phase 6 — Glue
- `commands/commands.test.ts`: returns all registered commands; basic `command`/`describe` presence.
- `index.test.ts`: bootstrap smoke test (no TTY), no unhandled exceptions.

### Coverage targets
- Overall ≥80%; critical modules (MetricsEngine, Workflow, tag command) ≥90%.
- Use fake timers for watchers/loops; snapshot/golden output for text-heavy commands.

### Tools maturity
- Vitest and built-in mocks: stable, mature.
- Headless UI mocks for `blessed`/`blessed-contrib`: conventional approach; low risk.

Your Humble Servant, Sebastién
